name: How long does a whole-house remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole-house remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-house remodel varies significantly based on the project's scope, the size of the home, and the complexity of the changes. A major remodel can take anywhere from six months to over a year to complete. Factors like obtaining permits, material availability, and unforeseen structural issues can also influence the timeline. We work to establish a realistic schedule during the planning phase and keep you informed of progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope, home size, and complexity. It can range from six months to over a year, with permits and material availability impacting the timeline.
